caller_tactics.text: Hello, Eszter? It's Priya Nair from Cedar Hollow Savings Bank. You asked about our savings accounts on our website, so I'm returning your enquiry.
Our standard savings account is a good fit for that. It's a simple account, and you can open it at any branch or online.
The rate for the twelve-month account is 4.1 percent a year, and it's fixed for the whole twelve months. It won't change during that time.
Deposits here are insured by the government up to the legal limit per depositor. The limit is shown on the disclosure sheet I'll send you.
You can withdraw early, but there's a small charge, and the rate for the remaining term is reduced. The exact terms are in the account agreement.
The minimum to open the account is five hundred dollars. There's no maximum set by us, though the deposit insurance limit still applies.
About fifteen minutes at a branch, or a little longer online. You don't have to decide today.
That's a sensible approach. I'll email you the disclosure sheet and the account agreement, and you can read them at your own pace.
After twelve months the account renews at the rate then on offer, which we'll tell you in writing before that date.
